title: Schemantic plate spec
description: A one-page architecture plate: what is on it, never where. Chromium lays it out; lint checks the result.

spec_version.description: Version of this spec format. Optional; 1 is the current version.

canvas.description: Page size, language and series badge.

size.description: landscape-4x3 is 1600 x 1200 (the default choice); landscape-16x9 is 1920 x 1080, for slides.

lang.description: Language of the fixed labels; follow the user. In nl, technical terms stay English.

series.description: Name of the series this plate belongs to.

part.description: This plate's number in the series; give `of` too.

of.description: Number of plates in the series; give `part` too.

title.description: The one message, as a claim.

subtitle.description: How the plate makes the title's claim true.

archetype.description: The body layout. Built: column-flow, hub-and-spokes, layer-cake; the others are planned and refused by lint.

layout.description: Where panels go, in terms of the archetype. Which keys apply depends on the archetype.

areas.description: column-flow: rows of panel ids, like CSS grid-template-areas; '.' is empty; a panel spans a rectangle.

column_widths.description: column-flow: relative column widths, one per column.

row_heights.description: One per row: fill shares the free height, auto hugs the content.

top.description: hub-and-spokes: spoke ids above the hub, left to right.

bottom.description: hub-and-spokes: spoke ids below the hub, left to right.

left.description: hub-and-spokes: a side spoke; layer-cake: a rail spanning every layer.

right.description: hub-and-spokes: a side spoke; layer-cake: a rail spanning every layer.

flows.description: Connectors between panels or cards; the router draws them around every box.

from.description: A panel id or card id.

to.description: A panel id or card id.

label.description: Short label beside the arrow; needs a run with room.

footer.description: Context, principles, open questions and the legend, under the body.

columns.description: Relative widths, one per footer panel present. Optional.

context.description: People or roles around the system.

principles.description: Decisions, each a full sentence a team could check.

open_questions.description: Open questions: warning chips (from_chips) plus extra ones.

legend.description: The legend is generated from what the plate uses.

card.description: A thing with a name inside a panel.

id.description: Needed only when a flow starts or ends at this card.

icon.description: An icon name from assets/icons (`schemantic icons <word>`).

qualifier.description: Shown in brackets after the name.

note.description: What the card does in this story; lowercase start, no full stop.

chip.description: A warning (open choice, repeated under open questions) or info (assumption) note in a panel.

pattern.description: A structured block inside a panel: tier strip, tree or matrix.

panel.description: A box on the plate holding cards, patterns and chips.

role.description: Colour with a meaning, shown in the legend: what the team runs, data, or outside the team's control.

arrange.description: row: blocks side by side instead of stacked.

weights.description: With arrange: row, relative widths: patterns first, then the cards block.
